main_text.head: ALAMANNICÆ E[?] SIÆ VETERIS LITANIA.
main_text.p: IN ITA oratione post Gloria in excelsis Deo dicit sacerdos: Christus vincit, Christus regnat, Christus imperat, tribus clerus.
